inlines.v: EXPANS'IVE, adjective Having the power to expand, to spread, or to dilate; as the expansive force of heat or fire. 1. Having the capacity of being expanded; as the expansive quality of air; the expansive atmosphere. 2. Widely extended; as expansive benevolence.
